claims.summary: The Patriots announce red throwback jerseys, white pants, and Pat Patriot helmets for this game.
The Patriots announce a pregame recognition of members of the 2001 championship team; individual attendance is unverified.
The Patriots announce Adam Vinatieri as the halftime Ring of Excellence honoree; his attendance is unverified.
